cause: An existing SaveStore auxiliary .bak symlink could load a different context even when its direct main path was rejected.
prerequisites: A preexisting symlink created by an actor with same-UID/private-directory access; ordinary other applications cannot create it, and the game never creates it.

profiles.scope: QStandardPaths simulated; SaveStore real; native APK must also pass emulator checks.

optimized_profiles.scope: QStandardPaths simulated; SaveStore real; native APK must also pass emulator checks.

native_case.check: Native private backup symlink rejected without cross-context recovery
native_case.platform: Android 15 / API 35 x86_64 / QPA android / optimize=2
